title: Interior kit, round 9
direction: A×C · Round 9 · the interior kit rewritten
summary: The reference sheet for the round-9 interior kit (kit-ac.css §12 'interior, round 9' and §13 'motion & imagery', as amended by plan §7): the GoNimbly-order head cast three ways (stacked at 104 over a film plate that is a clamped left-half crop of the frosted stand-in, tagged 'Stand-in'; side at 96, GoNimbly's head with its vertical hairline, over a shot card; stacked at 128 with a one-word accent over the readout's first page as a sheet), the Audit's approved facts head and the measure plate drawing its confirmed sequence, the type voices (.ac-key, .ac-spec--key, mono numerals only, .ac-state, .ac-go), a document sheet set as a spread, the claim and the big number, the form with its 56px outlined submit (.ac-btn-o--lg), the one close (with and without red), and the retired round-8 pieces — each with real Kelwin content.

reference.site: ROUND9-PLAN.md §2–§3; GoNimbly (the founder's recordings: picture plate under the headline, the headline writing itself in, few big sentence-case labels); the approved homepage kit (hero/T film, evidence/T and system/T masses, cta/U)
reference.borrowed: GoNimbly's head order (headline → short lede → one quiet action → a full-width moving picture) and its big, few, sentence-case labels; the hero film's frosted treatment for the plate; real document conventions (running head, folio, exhibits) for the sheet.
reference.kelwin: Graphite, paper and one red; Mona Sans in two voices; the kit's head grammar and 48×2 rule; pictures only inside .km-film, only left-half crops of the hero's frosted stand-in (never one of the hero's framings), tagged 'Stand-in', or a shot card where no crop fits; mono only for numerals.

motion: entrance (this standalone build): the kit's head choreography on each head (label, h1 line by line, rule, lede, the quiet action; the side head's hairline draws down), then each head plate rises as a narrower rectangle and widens to the full measure; the measure plate's dimension draws and its three labels fade in; body pieces rise once.

on the stitched pages (tool/home.py, lib/turn.js): the turn covers the page from the first paint, the Kelwin mark flickers on (K3, K2, K1) and the panel sweeps off; the page h1 (only it) writes itself in letter by letter (≈21ms apart, three hard steps each) with every glyph held at its set place and the set lines locked; the rule, the lede and the action follow its last letter, then the plate rises. The other heads keep the kit's rise.
ambient: the film plate's frosted stand-in drifts and its grain flickers (base.css .km-film). interaction: hover states only.
reduced motion: final state at once — no panel, no write-in, no rise.
notes: A builder reference, not a page, and not for the founder's review: it is far taller than the 1400px cap so every component can be seen at full size. The slim strips between parts are kit annotations (component · classes · where it is used); they are not site design and never ship. Heads A2, B and C carry h2s because a sheet has one h1; on a page each head's statement is the h1 (and only it writes). It carries one red button (the close) besides the label squares and rules. Copy is real Kelwin content from the round-8 pages and the round-9 answers (Q1 hiring, Q3 sequence and reply times, Q6 read times, Q7 careers); the readout excerpts are the approved specimen text, set as pages. The film plate is a crop of the hero's frosted stand-in (img/film-room.webp) inside its left half (zoom 2.6, x 10%, y 8%), tagged 'Stand-in'; the shot card is the stand-in for a shot not yet made and doubles as its brief.
